<!-- Generated by tools/cli-reference.py from `backdown completions --help`. Edit the help in crates/backdown-cli (or the notes in the script) and run it again. -->


```text
backdown completions [OPTIONS] [SHELL]
```

## Arguments

`[SHELL]`
: bash, zsh, fish, powershell or elvish (default: your shell, from $SHELL). One of `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `powershell`, `zsh`.

## Options

`--install`
: Put it where your shell picks it up, for you alone (bash, zsh, fish).

Also takes the [global options](/docs/cli/#global-options) `--db` and `--local`.
